# Real Apple DER entitlements blobs: the seven distinct blobs Apple's own `codesign --generate-entitlement-der` wrote.
#
# PROVENANCE
#   Source:    GitHub Actions run 44956044650 (Issue #71, Authorization D1), the credential-free DER diagnostic on macos-15-arm64,
#              Xcode 26.3 (17C529), macOS 15.8.2: 14 ad-hoc signings of DISPOSABLE SYNTHETIC programs (codesign -s -
#              --generate-entitlement-der) on the iOS and the macOS target. The blob is byte-identical across the plain,
#              xcodelike and logref signing variants and across both targets, for the same entitlements.
#   Extracted: the whole blob (magic 0xfade7172, length, DER) of each distinct entitlement shape, copied byte for byte from the
#              hex the probe (tool/der_entitlements_probe.py) printed in the job log. Each hex string was compared with the
#              blob in the log and with ~/Downloads/issue71-d1-der-findings.md, and its SHA-256 with the digest the probe printed.
#              These blobs were NOT made by tool/ipa_fixture.py and must never be regenerated by it or by any other tool of this
#              repository; they are the independent evidence that the DER parser agrees with Apple, not with itself.
#   Content:   synthetic entitlements only (fake team TESTTEAM00, bundle com.example.disposable, com.example.* keys). No
#              certificate, key, credential, account or personal data. The log is public.
#
# FORMAT     one blob per line, four fields separated by single spaces:  NAME  SIZE-IN-BYTES  SHA-256  HEX
# CASES      the signing cases that produced each blob are listed below, in a comment, for the record.
